violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Observed open containers of Mrs Gerrys items opened with no date marking.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Observed pizza boxes stored on the floor not 6" off the floor.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 140F or above during display or service. Observed fried chicken in hot holding to be at 125 degrees. Pizza being held between 116-125. Hot hold food needs to be held at 140 degrees or above.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Around drink machine needs to be clean more frequent.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Around stationary equipment on the floors need to be clean.
